elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The added clause only warrants that SFJ Services will conform to the Agreement; it does not impose an independent professional-and-workmanlike performance standard.

elements.element: Deliverables, including software, conform to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: Only software is covered, and its warranty is qualified to conformity “in all material respects.” Non-software deliverables are not expressly warranted to conform to documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty continues for 12 months following delivery.
elements.evidence: The operative warranty lasts only ninety days following delivery.

elements.element: The services performance warranty continues for 90 days following performance.
elements.evidence: The operative services warranty lasts only thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: SFJ must “repair” the non-conforming software or SFJ Services.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: SFJ must “replace” the non-conforming software or SFJ Services as an alternative remedy.

elements.element: Refund of the amounts paid is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: SFJ may “refund the amounts paid for” the non-conforming software or SFJ Services.

elements.element: SFJ performs the covered services and supplies the covered deliverables in compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: Section 2.2.2 requires legal compliance only for specified Clinical Trials and responsibilities connected with those trials; it does not clearly cover all services, software, and deliverables subject to the requested warranty.

elements.element: The software and deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No operative malicious-code warranty is included.

elements.element: SFJ provides a software performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: SFJ warrants that software delivered by it will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software warranty continues for 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: The software warranty expressly applies for ninety days following delivery.

elements.element: SFJ provides a services performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: SFJ warrants that the SFJ Services will conform to the requirements of the Agreement.

elements.element: The services warranty continues for 30 days following performance.
elements.evidence: The services warranty expressly applies for thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides repair as a remedy.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides replacement as a remedy.

elements.element: Refund of the amounts paid is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides a refund of the amounts paid as a remedy.

result.reason: The operative addition reaches the expressly stated fallback by providing 90-day software and 30-day services warranties with repair, replacement, or refund. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the professional-and-workmanlike and malicious-code warranties, does not broadly cover deliverables or legal compliance, and uses shorter durations. The addition is narrowly targeted and fits within Article 13’s disclaimer exception, although the remedy election and the pronoun “them” could be drafted more precisely.
